bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; counts(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "$1" 2>/dev/null; }; code=80; a=$(counts "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='room' AND enabled=TRUE AND length(source_commit)=40 AND length(trim(ci_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(gserver_runtime_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(telegram_e2e_evidence))>0 AND approved_by IS NOT NULL") || exit 101; test "$a" = 1 || code=$((code+1)); b=$(counts "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='announcement' AND enabled=TRUE AND length(source_commit)=40 AND length(trim(ci_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(gserver_runtime_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(telegram_e2e_evidence))>0 AND approved_by IS NOT NULL") || exit 102; test "$b" = 1 || code=$((code+2)); c=$(counts "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='room' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL") || exit 103; test "$c" -ge 3 || code=$((code+4)); d=$(counts "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='announcement' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL") || exit 104; test "$d" -ge 1 || code=$((code+8)); exit "$code"
